items: Cutting-Edge Android 15 Tablet - Unlock next-level performance with the latest Android 15 OS, designed for enhanced speed, smarter privacy features, and adaptive power efficiency. Enjoy smoother app navigation, improved security, and seamless compatibility with newest applications and games

Ample 30GB RAM + Expandable Storage - Multitask without limits on this 10.1 inch tablet. With 30GB RAM(8GB physical + 22GB virtual) and 64GB internal storage—expandable to 2TB—you have space for all apps, photos, and videos. Perfect for work and entertainment

Octa-Core Powered Performance - Powered by an advanced octa-core processor reaching up to 2.0GHz, this Android tablet handles gaming, video calls, and apps with ease. Enjoy buttery-smooth operation and enhanced energy efficiency

Vibrant 10.1-inch FHD InCell Display - Enjoy stunning clarity on the DEERTiNE tablet’s 10.1-inch 1280×800 resolution FHD screen. Protected by tempered glass and featuring Widevine L1 HD streaming, it offers vibrant visuals and durability

All-Day 6000mAh Battery & 5G Wi-Fi - Built for all-day use, the E15 tablet’s 6000mAh battery keeps you connected longer, it’s ideal for on-the-go use. Stay connected faster with 2.4G/5G Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5.0, and GPS, plus dual cameras for clear video calls and photos
